mechanism: Allopurinol may increase gentamicin nephrotoxicity by reducing renal clearance and increasing drug accumulation, while gentamicin-induced renal impairment can elevate allopurinol metabolite (alloxanthine) levels.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and gentamicin levels closely; adjust gentamicin dosing based on renal function; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antibiotics if renal function declines.
